mapper.select: SELECT b.idx, b.sabun, s.saname, b.title, b.content, b.file, b.created, b.updated FROM board b LEFT JOIN sawon s ON b.sabun = s.sabun ORDER BY b.idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (sabun, title, content, file, created, updated) VALUES (#{sabun}, #{title}, #{content}, #{file}, NOW(), NOW())
